heading: Regulations
lead: The Secretary is authorized to issue regulations to carry out the provisions of this subchapter.

notes.heading: References in Text
notes.text: For definition of Secretary, referred to in text, see section 2109 of this title.

notes.heading: Effective Date of 1980 Amendment
notes.text: Amendment by Pub. L. 96–347 effective on 90th day after Sept. 12, 1980, see section 3 of Pub. L. 96–347, set out as a note under section 2109 of this title.

notes.heading: Effective Date
notes.text: Section effective on 90th day after May 16, 1972, see section 10 of Pub. L. 92–297, set out as a note under section 3381 of this title.
